subject.title: improve(ios): guide first-run users into gateway onboarding

question: Should the iOS preview-tour first-run experience in this PR be rebased and adopted on top of the current onboarding baseline, narrowed into a smaller follow-up, or closed in favor of the newer onboarding direction?
rationale: The branch adds a product-level preview/sample onboarding mode while main has since landed overlapping onboarding, routing, security-copy, and typography decisions, so automation cannot safely choose the desired user experience.

options.title: Rebase and adopt preview tour
options.body: Keep the feature direction, but require conflict resolution, branded typography, configured-user routing preservation, and fresh first-run/preview/configured-offline proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow to a smaller follow-up
options.body: Extract only the sample-preview pieces maintainers still want and leave connection-path or short-code setup work to the focused onboarding PRs.

options.title: Pause or close this branch
options.body: Treat the merged onboarding refresh and open focused onboarding PRs as the maintained direction if the preview-tour product surface is no longer desired.

recommendation.title: Rebase and adopt preview tour
recommendation.body: Keep the feature direction, but require conflict resolution, branded typography, configured-user routing preservation, and fresh first-run/preview/configured-offline proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The most recent merged startup-routing fix is on the same first-run/configured-user decision surface and is the clearest current-main routing ownership signal.
